_meta.description: Vendor intelligence manifest for ShadowCheck SIGINT forensics platform. Maps surveillance_type keys to vendor profiles and attached reference documents.

source_types.leaked: Leaked internal documents (operator manuals, price lists, internal specs)
source_types.foia: Documents obtained via Freedom of Information Act requests
source_types.manufacturer: Official manufacturer product pages, datasheets, and brochures
source_types.public: Publicly available news, research, or government reports

threat_tiers.1: Active IMSI catcher / cellular interception platform

vendors.description: Manufacturer of the Stingray, Hailstorm, AmberJack, KingFish, and Gemini IMSI catcher product line. Devices impersonate cell towers to intercept calls, texts, and location data.

docs.title: Long-Secret Stingray Manuals Detail How Police Can Spy on Phones
docs.summary: Full operator manuals for Stingray II, Hailstorm, AmberJack, KingFish. Includes Gemini Windows control software details. Published by The Intercept after FOIA release.

docs.title: KingFish Product Description (ACLU FOIA)
docs.summary: Harris Corp official product description for KingFish portable IMSI catcher, released via Florida FOIA request. Covers capabilities, form factor, and operational use.

docs.title: Rochester PD Unredacted Harris Corp Stingray Price List
docs.summary: Unredacted price list for Harris Corp Stingray devices obtained via Rochester PD FOIA request. Lists model numbers, unit prices, and accessories.

vendors.description: Israeli surveillance technology company. Products include Guardian IMSI catcher, WiFi Catcher, and Identities Catcher for cellular and WiFi interception.

docs.title: Septier Products Index
docs.summary: Official Septier product catalog including Guardian IMSI catcher, WiFi Catcher, and Identities Catcher product lines.

docs.title: Septier Identities Catcher — Device Report
docs.summary: Third-party device report entry for Septier Identities Catcher surveillance platform.

vendors.description: Intelligence and surveillance technology company. Government division provides lawful intercept, SIGINT, and communications intelligence platforms to law enforcement and intelligence agencies.

docs.title: Verint CX Automation (Main Site)
docs.summary: Verint main corporate site. Government/intelligence product lines are not publicly detailed; site redirects to commercial CX products.

docs.title: Transparency Toolkit SII — Wayback Listing
docs.summary: Wayback Machine listing for Transparency Toolkit's Surveillance Industry Index (SII), which catalogued Verint and other surveillance vendors.

docs.title: Transparency Toolkit SII — Wayback Index
docs.summary: Wayback Machine snapshot index for sii.transparencytoolkit.org, a database of surveillance industry companies and products.

docs.title: Verint Engage GI2/PI2/SI2 — Full Product List (SII)
docs.summary: 24-page Verint product list from the Surveillance Industry Index. Covers Engage GI2 (passive GSM off-air monitoring), Engage PI2 (phone tracking), Engage SI2, Inmarsat/Thuraya interception, speech recognition, and IP monitoring active/passive.

docs.title: Comverse Infosys RELIANT — Cryptome Leak
docs.summary: 2002 Cryptome publication of Comverse Infosys (Verint predecessor) internal product profile. Describes RELIANT lawful intercept system, STAR-GATE delivery platform, and global deployment in 50+ countries. CALEA/ETSI compliant.

docs.title: Verint Colombia — Privacy International Report
docs.summary: Privacy International press release documenting Verint's contracts with Colombian DAS, DIPOL, and DIJIN for mass surveillance systems. Verint provided network probes and Integrated Recording System even after DAS was outed for illegal surveillance.

vendors.description: German test and measurement company. Produces spectrum analyzers, signal analyzers, and WLAN test equipment used in both commercial and government/military SIGINT applications.

docs.title: Rohde & Schwarz Test & Measurement Products
docs.summary: Official R&S product catalog for test and measurement equipment including spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and network analyzers.

docs.title: WLAN IEEE 802.11 Application Note
docs.summary: R&S application note on frequency range extension of spectrum analyzers with harmonic mixers for WLAN/802.11 testing. Relevant to RF monitoring capabilities.

docs.title: R&S FSH Handheld Spectrum Analyzer — Product Brochure
docs.summary: Official Rohde & Schwarz FSH product brochure covering FSH4/8/13/20 models. Functions include spectrum analysis, WLAN/LTE OTA analysis, cable and antenna analysis, and interference hunting. Primary field instrument for RF surveillance teams.

docs.title: R&S FSH Technical Specifications
docs.summary: Official R&S FSH specifications document covering all model variants (FSH4/8/13/20), frequency ranges, dynamic range, noise figure, and optional firmware applications.

vendors.description: Defense contractor providing C4ISR, tactical communications, and intelligence systems. Products include encrypted radios, network infrastructure, and ISR platforms for military and government use.

docs.title: General Dynamics Mission Systems — Products & Solutions
docs.summary: Full GD Mission Systems product catalog covering C4ISR, cyber, intelligence, and tactical communications systems.

docs.title: GD Mission Systems Portfolio — C4ISR Capabilities
docs.summary: General Dynamics article presenting their Mission Systems portfolio for C4ISR and defense capabilities.

docs.title: GDIT Network & Communications Capabilities
docs.summary: GDIT (General Dynamics IT) capabilities page for network and communications services including enterprise networking, cybersecurity, and government IT infrastructure.

vendors.description: Defense contractor specializing in airborne ISR, electronic warfare, and tactical communications. Products include BACN (Battlefield Airborne Communications Node) and various airborne surveillance platforms.

docs.title: Northrop Grumman Airborne ISR
docs.summary: Northrop Grumman airborne intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance capabilities page covering sensor systems, mission systems, and ISR platforms.

docs.title: Northrop Grumman BACN Communications
docs.summary: Northrop Grumman Battlefield Airborne Communications Node (BACN) page. BACN is an airborne communications relay and gateway system used for tactical communications bridging.

vendors.description: Defense electronics company (formerly DRS Technologies). Produces tactical communications, ISR sensors, and electronic warfare systems for military applications.

docs.title: Leonardo DRS Products & Services
docs.summary: Leonardo DRS main products and services page covering tactical systems, ground systems, naval systems, and advanced sensing.

vendors.description: UK defense and communications company. Communications and connectivity division produces satellite communications, tactical radios, and RF systems for military and government use.

docs.title: Cobham Communications & Connectivity
docs.summary: Cobham communications and connectivity product index via Wayback Machine snapshot. Covers satellite communications, tactical data links, and RF systems.

vendors.description: Canadian satellite communications company. Produces portable and mobile SATCOM terminals, amplifiers, and satellite modems used in military and government communications.

docs.title: Norsat Products Index
docs.summary: Norsat full product catalog including portable satellite terminals, BUCs, LNBs, and satellite modems for military and government SATCOM applications.

vendors.description: Network equipment manufacturer. MAX series routers with SpeedFusion bonding are widely used in mobile surveillance vehicles, law enforcement, and tactical communications for multi-WAN failover.

docs.title: Peplink MAX Series Router Comparison
docs.summary: Peplink MAX series product comparison page covering 5G, LTE, and multi-WAN routers. MAX BR1 Pro and similar models are commonly deployed in mobile surveillance and law enforcement vehicles.

docs.title: Peplink BR1 Pro Product Page
docs.summary: Peplink MAX BR1 Pro product page with specifications, features, and use cases including public safety and mobile command.

docs.title: Peplink SpeedFusion Technology
docs.summary: SpeedFusion WAN bonding and failover technology overview. Used in mobile surveillance and tactical communications for resilient multi-carrier connectivity.

vendors.description: Network equipment manufacturer. NanoBeam and UniFi AC Mesh products are commonly used in fixed surveillance infrastructure, CCTV backhaul, and point-to-point links for surveillance networks.

docs.title: Ubiquiti NanoBeam NBE-5AC-Gen2 Datasheet
docs.summary: Official Ubiquiti NanoBeam NBE-5AC-Gen2 datasheet. High-gain 5GHz point-to-point bridge commonly used in surveillance camera backhaul and fixed monitoring infrastructure.

docs.title: Ubiquiti UniFi AC Mesh Datasheet
docs.summary: Ubiquiti UniFi AC Mesh access point datasheet. Outdoor mesh AP used in surveillance networks and public area monitoring.

vendors.description: Wireless broadband equipment manufacturer. PMP 450 series fixed wireless access products are used in surveillance infrastructure, smart city deployments, and government communications networks.

docs.title: Cambium Networks PMP 450 Product Page
docs.summary: Cambium PMP 450 fixed wireless access product page. PMP 450 series is widely deployed in government and surveillance infrastructure.

docs.title: Cambium Networks Products Index
docs.summary: Cambium Networks full product catalog including PMP, PTP, and cnWave product lines.

docs.title: Cambium PMP 450i Datasheet
docs.summary: Official Cambium PMP 450i datasheet with specifications for the fixed wireless access platform.

vendors.description: Israeli IMSI catcher and off-air interception company founded 1994 in Tel Aviv. Products include IBIS, the Unlimited Interceptor (ULIN) SS7-based global interception system, GoDown cellular jammer, and In-Between GSM/UMTS/LTE active interception systems. Sold to defense ministries, national agencies, and law enforcement worldwide.

docs.title: The Spy Files: How Safe Are Your Emails and Phone Calls?
docs.summary: Bureau of Investigative Journalism coverage of WikiLeaks Spy Files release. Documents Ability Inc as an IMSI catcher vendor alongside Harris Corp and Rohde & Schwarz. Describes IBIS product capabilities and global law enforcement sales.

vendors.description: Israeli defense electronics company. Tadiran Communications (acquired by Elbit Systems) produces the CNR-710, CNR-9000, and E-LynX SDR tactical radio families widely deployed by IDF and allied militaries. E-LynX supports VHF/UHF/L-Band with wideband MANET networking for land, air, maritime, and dismounted forces.

docs.title: E-LynX VHF/UHF SDR — Full Product Line
docs.summary: Elbit Systems Deutschland product page for the complete E-LynX SDR family. Covers handheld (<800g, 30-512MHz), manpack, vehicular (50W RF head, 30MHz-1.8GHz), airborne, and SATCOM configurations. Includes E-LynX Intercom, Tactical Router, and Soldier Radio.

docs.title: Tadiran CNR-9000 — VHF/FM Tactical Radio
docs.summary: Tadiran CNR-9000 VHF/FM tactical radio. Software-defined architecture with P3I growth path. CNR-9000HDR variant achieves 115 kbps VHF data rate. Standard radio of the IDF and multiple allied militaries.
